'''Outpost GRF-7493''' was a small [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].

==History==
The outpost was promptly constructed during the [[Empire Day/Legends|Empire Day]] festivities of [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. It was during this particular Empire Day that the outpost was inhabited by an [[Unidentified Imperial commander (Yavin 4)|Imperial commander]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and a number of other Imperial soldiers. An [[Jedi Prisoner|imprisoned Jedi]] was held there for interrogation, and presumably execution.<ref name="SWG:HED" />

Following Empire Day, Vader left the outpost to pursue other matters. The outpost remained as a minor Imperial foothold on the world, but went mostly unused. Nonetheless, an [[Imperial recruiter]], a number of [[Novatrooper]]s and several [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transports]] still patrolled the facility.<ref name="SWG:HED" />

==Behind the scenes==
Outpost GRF-7493 was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:HED" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Outpost GRF-7493 was added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 19 Notes for 29 June 2005|Publish 19]]," on [[June 29]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Update Notes: Publish 19.0 - June 29th, 2005">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=757|text=Update Notes: Publish 19.0 - June 29th, 2005}}</ref> During the 2005 [[W:c:swg:Empire Day|Empire Day]] live event from June 29 to [[July 11]], 2005,<ref name="SonyCite-Friday Feature – Empire Day 2005">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Friday%20Feature%20-%20Empire%20Day|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Empire Day (2005)}}</ref> Imperial players had to go this location to complete a quest titled "[[W:c:swg:Happy Empire Day!|Happy Empire Day!]]."<ref name="SWG:HED" /> After the live event ended, the outpost remained, but served no real purpose since the Empire Day event was discontinued until its complete overhaul in [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Friday Feature – Empire Day 2008">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67814&month=062008|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Empire Day (2008)}}</ref>
